requirements.text: The supervisor circuit-breaker limit for consecutive revision loops is raised from 4 to 6, authorized by the owner for the orchestrator to apply. Concretely: add `max_consecutive_revision_loops = 6` under a `[limits]` table in the immutable controller config `C:\Program Files\SupervisorConfig\config.toml` (the exact dataclass field name - unknown keys fail closed per config.py S2.2), then re-record the launch manifest that digest-pins that config (`python -m tools.agent_supervisor record-manifest --config "C:\Program Files\SupervisorConfig\config.toml"` writing the manifest both launchers consume) so the next supervised launch on EVERY loop verifies and runs under the new limit. The change is config-scoped only: the code default in tools/agent_supervisor/config.py stays 4; no other limit, gate, hold, authority, isolation, or model-selection value changes; live in-flight runs keep the limit they launched with and are never disturbed mid-run to apply this.
requirements.required_harness: The first supervised run launched after the change emits its budget counter_limits with consecutive_revision_loops = 6 (the launch-time audit budget event), and the launcher's manifest verification passes at that launch.
requirements.required_evidence: config.toml [limits] content; record-manifest output/manifest digest; the next run's budget counter_limits audit line showing 6
requirements.status_reason: Captured before acting; applied and verified per the harness after capture.
